Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 2019
ACT XIII OF 2019
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles
Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
2nd December, 2019]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-26/2019, dated 2.12.2019.---The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 08th November 2019 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 27th November, 2019 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Provincial
Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Amendment of section 2 of the West Pakistan Ordinance No.XIX of 1965

PAS/LEGIS-B-26/2019, dated 2.12.2019.---The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 08th November 2019 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 27th November, 2019 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Provincial
Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 2 of the West Pakistan Ordinance No.XIX of 1965.---In the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance,
1965, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, in
subsection (15), after the words "defect or disability", the words
"including differently abled persons with hearing impairment" shall
be inserted.

Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Provincial
Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Amendment
of section 7 of the West Pakistan Ordinance No.XIX of 1965.---In the said Ordinance, in section 7, in
subsection (5), in the proviso, after clause (b), the following shall be
added:-
"(c) the
applicant with hearing impairment having up to 40 DB hearing loss shall wear
hearing aids and in case the hearing loss exceeds 40 DB, the applicant shall
use assistive technology devices or means as per description vehicle of special
type mentioned in Form-A(k) of First Schedule.".
"(d) the
person who will take the driving test should know sign language or should be
assisted by a person who knows sign language.
"(e) no
license fee shall be charged from such person.
Provided
that the vehicles of such persons shall attach mandatory stickers on their
vehicles, as may be prescribed.
